subject: Post-incident SLA proposal & renewal timing — FinLedger
raw:
From: Jordan Klein <jk@finledger.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@finledger.com
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production incidents + upcoming renewal — request for SLA upgrade

Connor,

Thanks for taking the time to speak last week. We had three production-impact incidents across the payments flow in the last 30 days (timestamps attached) that caused elevated latency and a handful of timeouts for end users. Our security and ops teams have catalogued the incidents — I attached a short summary.

FinLedger is up for renewal in December and, after the outages, we need stronger uptime commitments and lower tail-latency guarantees to move forward comfortably. Specifically: 
- 99.99% uptime across all API endpoints (we saw regionally scoped blips)
- P95 latency <= 120ms for emb/call endpoints; P99 action plan for bursts
- Clear escalation and credit policy for incidents that breach SLOs

We'd like to discuss moving to a premium SLA tier (dedicated capacity or reserved pool) and understand what commitment you can make on credits and remediation timelines. Procurement is cc'd — please include pricing or a short proposal we can review before our renewal meeting later this month.

Attachment(s): incident_summary_20261027.pdf (pdf)

Jordan Klein
Head of Engineering, FinLedger
jk@finledger.com

-----Original Message-----
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Klein <jk@finledger.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 09:36:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Production incidents + upcoming renewal — request for SLA upgrade

Jordan — thanks for the note and the summary. I’m really sorry these incidents impacted FinLedger; I appreciate the clear asks. 

I copied our Renewal & Reliability leads internally so we can respond with an operational proposal and a pricing view. Quick next steps I propose:
- I’ll send a preliminary premium SLA term sheet and an option for a 30-day dedicated pilot (isolated pool) by end of day Friday.
- Schedule a 30-min call next week with your ops team to review incident root causes and proposed mitigations.

Would 11/02 or 11/03 work on your side for the call?

Regards,
Connor O'Brien

Subject: FW: FinLedger — incident summary + SLA ask (renewal risk)

Team — forwarding FinLedger's summary and their explicit ask for 99.99% + latency guarantees. Renewal is in Dec (deal DL-7843). They are a key payments customer (scale: ~1.2M monthly transactions). High urgency.

What we need:
- Evelyn: operational proposal — can we offer a 30-day dedicated pilot (reserved pool + burst capacity) and what mitigations will reduce tail latency? Outline required SRE commitments and runbook changes.
- Laura: draft an SLA amendment with credit schedule and escalation path (DocuSign-ready). Start with a premium tier: 99.99% monthly uptime with P95/P99 latency thresholds.
- Rishi: commercial impact — estimate uplift (T&M + reserved capacity) and recommended discounting/credits structure for renewal.

Also flagging we may need a one-time credit for the incidents to preserve relationship; be conservative with financials until we see Evelyn's proposal.

Attachment(s) included from customer: incident_summary_20261027.pdf

Connor

-----Message 4 (internal reply)-----
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 11:05:33 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: FinLedger — incident summary + SLA ask (renewal risk)

Connor, Laura, Evelyn — quick commercial note: moving FinLedger to a premium SLA with reserved capacity and 99.99% target will increase ARR by ~35% for this account at standard pricing; margin profile is higher due to committed usage.

However, we should consider a one-time concession: a service credit equal to 10% of the prior quarter's invoice (to acknowledge the outages) and a 3-month ramp discount on reserved rates (15% off) tied to a 12-month renewal commitment. This buys goodwill while protecting long-term economics.

I'll model the impact and share revised numbers by EOD Friday. If legal needs a tighter credit formula (per-month vs per-incident), loop them in.

—Rishi

-----Message 5 (final to customer)-----
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Klein <jk@finledger.com>
Cc: procurement@finledger.com, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: premium SLA + dedicated pilot (FinLedger renewal)

Jordan — thanks again for the detailed incident notes and for the candid conversation last week. We want to keep FinLedger on a reliable footing and make the renewal straightforward. Summary of our proposal: 

1) Pilot + Capacity
- 30-day dedicated pilot (isolated GPU pool) starting as soon as onboarding is complete; target start 2026-11-17. Pilot parameters attached (dedicated_pilot_params.xlsx).

2) SLA & Credits
- Premium SLA: 99.99% monthly uptime across API endpoints; P95 latency <= 120ms; P99 action plan and remediation timeline of 4 business hours for critical incidents.
- Credit policy: monthly service credits up to 30% of that month's invoice for sustained breaches; one-time good-faith credit equal to 10% of Q3 invoice applied at renewal signing. Draft amendment attached (SLA_amendment_v2.docx).

3) Commercial terms
- Annual reserved commitment (12 months) with 15% ramp discount for first 3 months; net uplift ~32% ARR compared to current consumption baseline.
- DocuSign-ready amendment link: https://docusign.com/link/finledger-sla-DL7843 (expires in 14 days).

4) Next steps
- Please confirm interest in the 30-day pilot by 2026-11-13 so we can provision capacity.
- We can schedule a 30-min runbook review with your ops team next week.

Attachments: SLA_amendment_v2.docx (Word), dedicated_pilot_params.xlsx (xlsx)

If you’d like, we can also include a post-pilot 1-month performance review and a joint SLA scorecard to be reviewed quarterly. Happy to walk through details on a short call.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
